examples.text: Tom vem aqui quase todo sábado.
examples.en: Tom comes here almost every Saturday.

examples.text: Não vamos à escola aos sábados.
examples.en: We don't go to school on Saturdays.

examples.text: Hoje é sábado, e amanhã será domingo.
examples.en: Today is Saturday and tomorrow is Sunday.
Do you have to go to school on Saturdays?

examples.text: Eu esqueci que hoje é sábado.
examples.en: I forgot that today was Saturday.
